_PAGE_PLUGIN_PROPS_DEFAULT_INTRODUCTION_:
Introduction

APropsDefaultPlugin sets the default values of the props for all components in one place. The key is the name of the component (for example AModal), the value is an object with the props. A prop that is passed to the component always wins.
_PAGE_PLUGIN_PROPS_DEFAULT_NOTES_:
Notes

  • Every component has its own entry: AModalForm does not take the values of AModal, ASelectIcon does not take the values of ASelect.
  • Several calls of app.use are merged per component.
  • undefined can be set as a default too.
  • Objects and arrays are shared by all instances: do not change them in the component.
  • The defaults are read when a component is created.

Other plugins
